record.what_it_does: Data-driven, customizable CRM for managing relationships, records, lists, and workflows.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (PKCE required for user-level tokens) is recommended for multi-workspace apps. API keys are generated per workspace in developer settings. Both are sent as Bearer tokens, and Basic auth is also accepted. Workspace-level tokens need an admin to grant them.
record.access_notes: The pricing page lists "API and webhooks" across all plans including Free, with a free plan for up to 3 users. That is inferred from the table, which showed no explicit checkmarks. SQL access via API/MCP is Ultra-only. An unpublished OAuth app can be installed in up to 25 workspaces. Wider distribution means sharing the app or publishing it, and the publishing and code-review requirements pages were not opened, so a review step may apply.
record.api_breadth_notes: REST API covering objects, records, lists, entries, attributes, notes, tasks, comments, meetings, webhooks, and more. Operations were not counted from the endpoint reference.
record.blocker_notes: Public OAuth distribution beyond 25 workspaces may require publishing and review in the Attio App Store, which was not confirmed. A free workspace can serve as a test environment.

evidence.quote: You should prefer the OAuth 2.0 flow if building an app for multiple workspaces.
An unpublished app can be installed in up to 25 workspaces.
Attio's hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.
Webhooks let you subscribe to changes in Attio and receive real-time notifications at a URL you choose.
Access the OpenAPI specification for the Attio REST API

record.needs_human: Confirm whether publishing an OAuth app to more than 25 workspaces needs Attio review (see the publication lifecycle and App Store pages). Confirm API access is free-tier eligible, since the pricing table was ambiguous. Confirm whether any sandbox or test workspace exists beyond a free workspace.
